answer: Random transcript audit works like spot-checking a ledger with a fresh dice roll each time. Each epoch the chain selects one past answer per agent, draws a fresh nonce from a nebula of rotating entropy sources, and demands the agent re-derive the reasoning live, so a cached or borrowed reply fails the delta comparison. First mismatch logs a ripple flag; second within 24 hours freezes emission and routes identity to manual review. Faking 20000 identities to survive the audit costs roughly 480000 tokens and 96 operator hours over a 21-day voyage of exposure—cheaper to be real.
